retrieval_skill.name: regime_driver_timeline
retrieval_skill.description: Build an evidence-backed timeline that separates measurement artifacts, temporary interventions, normalization expectations, and genuine future drivers before forecasting.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When historical observations may contain anomalies or promotions and public evidence may explain both their resolution and the forecast regime.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for the subject together with anomaly cause, remediation, promotion dates, normalization guidance, forecast-window outlook, and quantified drivers; extract claims by mechanism layer and retain their temporal scope and provenance.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept each claim only when a reliable source directly supports its wording, timing, and applicability; distinguish observed facts from expectations, confirm that anomalies were resolved before the forecast window, and never infer an exact quote or quantitative future effect beyond the cited evidence.
